1. Project Overview

An AI-powered document assistant that lets users upload PDFs, ask questions in natural language, and
receive document-grounded answers with source references. Built on two pillars: Large Language Models
(LLMs) via Google Gemini, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for grounded, context-aware
responses.

Beyond Q&A, the system delivers document summarization and automatic question generation (MCQs +
short-answer).

Core User Experience: A user uploads a PDF, asks a question in everyday language, and receives an
answer grounded in the document - with page or source reference where available.

2. Project Objective & Goals

Design and implement a practical AI application that understands user questions about uploaded PDF
documents, retrieves relevant passages, and generates useful responses with the help of an LLM.

✓ Build a user-friendly PDF upload & query interface
✓ Understand the basic LLM-powered application workflow
✓ Implement text extraction, chunking, embeddings & vector search
✓ Use RAG to ground generated answers in retrieved content
✓ Add summarization & quiz generation features
